az_count.description: Number of availability zones to use

kubernetes_version.description: Kubernetes version for the EKS cluster

node_persistent_instance_type.description: EC2 instance type for the persistent node group; empty resolves the declared criteria against the platform's instance catalog

node_persistent_count.description: Number of nodes in the persistent node group; elastic bounds belong with a cluster autoscaler

node_persistent_disk_size.description: Root volume size (GB) for the persistent nodes

node_ephemeral_instance_type.description: EC2 instance type for the ephemeral node group; empty resolves the declared criteria against the platform's instance catalog

node_ephemeral_count.description: Number of nodes in the ephemeral node group; elastic bounds belong with a cluster autoscaler

node_ephemeral_disk_size.description: Root volume size (GB) for the ephemeral nodes
